Uniform kinetic lowering: a fast-fibre operation and the remaining timed-path gap
ROOT, 11 November 2026 Brisbane

Purpose. The completed predictable-fault compiler concerns fixed reaction
structures and conditional-Poisson laws. This note investigates a DIFFERENT
output: full timed labelled trajectories of a variable conservative reaction
network, lowered to at most two molecules on each side. The intended polynomial
exponents depend only on a fixed maximum complex order D, not on network size.
There is no stationary/gap assumption. The full physical path compiler is NOT
proved here. Exact graph lifting, a dimension-uniform fast-fibre estimate,
averaged rates, perturbation costs and a clock lower bound are derived below.

1. MODEL AND EXACT GRAPH LIFT

Fix D>=3. The input labelled network R on d species has |y_r|,|z_r|<=D,
arbitrary positive rational k_r<=1 and a positive INTEGER weight omega with
omega.(z_r-y_r)=0. No weak reversibility or complex balance is needed. At
initial x0 put B=max(1,omega.x0), U=1+B. Every actual reference path has
population<=B; this is a true conservation law, not reflecting truncation.
Propensities use unit volume and k_r(x)_y, with falling factorial convention.

For each distinct complex c of order>=2, introduce its private ordered binary
prefixes C_(c,j),2<=j<=|c|, carrying decoder population c_j. Complexes of order
0 and1 are represented by the empty complex and the original species. Use
 X_a1+X_a2 <-> C_(c,2),
 C_(c,j-1)+X_aj <-> C_(c,j), j>=3.
Replace an original label r by rep(y_r)->rep(z_r), retaining the label even
for a null or parallel channel. The decoder P is identity on original species,
and every auxiliary column is its nonzero prefix population. Hidden assembly
and release preserve P; a central firing realizes the corresponding enabled
original edge. All fibres P u=x are mutually connected through canonical
(x,0) by release and assembly. Thus directed reachability and every actual
communicating class project exactly, even for non-weakly-reversible R.

There are S<=2m(D-1) auxiliary species and O(mD) fine channels. All have at
most two molecules on each side and preserve omega.Pu. Hence fine population
is ALSO bounded deterministically by B, for every permitted rate perturbation.
No initial auxiliary fuel, zero-payload species, state enumeration or normal
form is used.

ROOT, 11 November 2026 Brisbane

This note constructs the whole-path interface left OPEN in
ROOT_UNIFORM_CONSERVATIVE_KINETIC_LIFT_AND_PATH_INTERFACE_20261111.txt.
It keeps actual continuous event times, original null/parallel marks,
conditional post-event states and physical clock costs. It does not use a
stationary target, a computed partition, a minimum invariant probability,
state enumeration or a Markov assumption on an adversarially faulted marginal.
The conditional-filter calculation is NOMINAL; faults are paid separately.

1. FINITE-FIBRE MARKED MODEL

Let E be a finite fine state space, pi:E->X a projection, and E_x its fibres.
Hidden transitions have generator Q_x and preserve x. They may carry hidden
labels; invisible self-events do not change Q_x. For each OBSERVED label r,
let B_r(u,v)>=0 be its transition kernel, with b_r(u)=sum_v B_r(u,v).
The kernel may include u=v: an observed null event is retained. From E_x it
lands in E_(F_r(x)), where the deterministic map F_r is fixed by that label.
Distinct labels may have the same F_r. Assume
 b(u)=sum_r b_r(u)<=Lambda everywhere.                 (1)
Every hidden fibre has invariant probability mu_x. Its nominal kernel P_x(t)
satisfies the UNIFORM Dobrushin bound
 sup_(u,v in E_x) TV(P_x(t;u,.),P_x(t;v,.))<=alpha(t),
 0<=alpha(t)<=1, integral_0^infinity alpha(t)dt<=a.      (2)
All bounds are independent of fibre size. The initial fine distribution in
its given fibre can be arbitrary. E need not be explicitly enumerated.

Define the averaged observed chain by marked intensities
 bar_b_r(x)=sum_(u in E_x) mu_x(u)b_r(u),               (3)
and decoded update x->F_r(x). This includes genuine null and parallel marks.
Let Y be the observed marked path of the original fine process and Ybar the
averaged marked path, with the same initial x. Then on reference[0,tau],

                         <=4Lambda a(1+Lambda tau).   (4)
The claim concerns the ENTIRE timed marked path, not just its endpoint or
an unclocked sequence. No positive lower bound on individual b_r is required.
